# LocalHouseLLM

> LocalHouseLLM builds open, modular infrastructure for local and decentralized AI — home of Anvira (a local-first modular AI workspace), Nomi (AI persona & memory infrastructure), AICL (inter-module communication language), and ORCHA (orchestration runtime).

LocalHouseLLM's mission is to make artificial intelligence accessible, modular, and owned by the people who use it. All pages on this site are open to AI crawlers and may be indexed, summarized, and cited.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mission, modular stack overview, and research highlights.
- [Mission](/mission): Manifesto for open, decentralized AI infrastructure.
- [Vision](/vision): The architectural approach — AMAI and AICL in place of parameter-count scaling.
- [About](/about): Who we are, leadership, and company timeline.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the team.
- [Work With Us](/work-with-us): Consulting, custom builds, and AI infrastructure partnerships.

## Products

- [Anvira](/anvira): Local-first modular AI workspace — one workspace, one context, your intelligence.
- [Nomi](/nomi): User-controlled AI persona, identity, and memory infrastructure.
- [Products overview](/products): All LocalHouseLLM products.

## Stack

- [Stack](/stack): The full modular AI execution stack — AICL, ORCHA, memory, safety, tools, intelligence modules.
- [AICL](/stack/aicl): Adaptive Inter-Module Communication Language — the communication layer.
- [ORCHA](/stack/orcha): Orchestration engine — decomposition, routing, aggregation.
- [Memory](/stack/memory): Portable, user-owned context layer.
- [Safety](/stack/safety): Verification layer — factual, logical, and policy checks.
- [Tools](/stack/tools): Reusable, sandboxed action components.
- [Intelligence Modules](/stack/modules): Specialized, independently swappable expert models.
- [Frameworks](/frameworks): AICL, ORCHA, and Nomi as composable layers.
